component.name: NetPulse
component.summary: Diagnose network problems from one window

description.p: NetPulse puts the classic network tools into a calm, simple interface. It runs the real programs on your computer and shows their output live, together with an easy-to-read summary.

ul.li: Ping with a live round-trip chart, traceroute and MTR hop tables
DNS lookups with dig, nslookup and host, reverse DNS and whois
Compare the answers of several DNS resolvers side by side
HTTP(S) checks with a timing breakdown, and TLS certificate details
TCP port checks, local network information and a subnet calculator
A quick diagnose report for a single host

description.p: Results can be copied or exported as text, JSON or Markdown, and every run is kept in a searchable history. NetPulse works offline, has light and dark themes and sends nothing anywhere except the network tests you start.

screenshot.caption: Ping with a live round-trip chart (light theme)
